description: Convert layers with a Layer menu command: Create Shapes from Text (new shape layers with the outlines), Create Masks from Text (a solid with a mask per character), or Convert to Editable Text (Photoshop text layers to After Effects text). Selects the layers and runs the command in their composition

action.description: shapes: Create Shapes from Text; masks: Create Masks from Text; editable: Convert to Editable Text

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

name: convert_text_layers
title: Convert Text Layers
